event_data.context:
Baseline: eventcore-v2.1.0 (fea3e386cce904e9ef9b76cd303926870d04a692). Follow the upstream source and observable acceptance scenarios at https://github.com/10krco/eventcore-gl/blob/main/docs/parity.md#command-runtime-and-in-memory-store and record passing Gleam test evidence.

Progress: the optimistic store contract and OTP adapter passed local gates and CI on PR #2. The App approved that revision and raised incremental read performance and store lifetime concerns. Reviewing those findings. The command executor compiles locally. Its conflict replay fixture is being corrected and its delivery will follow the adapter PR.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the command runtime and in-memory store capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Command runtime and in-memory store
